routes.empty: This route has no steps yet. "Edit this route…" builds it.

routes.rulesTitle_other: {count} things to fix in this route
routes.outside: The routes are read from the factory server.
routes.failed: The route could not be read

rule.TOO_FEW: A route has two steps or more.
rule.DEPARTMENT_CLOSED: A closed department was added: take it out, or open it again under Manage.
rule.other: The factory server does not accept this route as it is.
rule.NO_QUALITY: No quality check in this route.

held.noRight: Only the production manager changes a route.
held.archived: This product is archived: its route stays as it is.
held.noRevision: This product has no revision yet.
held.draftOpen: Revision {revision} is released and revision {draft} is the draft: open revision {draft} to change the route.
held.released: Revision {revision} is released. Start revision {next} to change the route.
held.departmentsFailed: The departments could not be read: try again.

who.title: Who decides the route
who.answer: The most exact level wins. One product is never made in two ways by mistake.

product.label: 1 · The product
product.value: Its normal route. The production manager builds it, on a draft.

model.label: 2 · A model or a customer
model.value: Its own route for the same product. The production manager builds it; sales picks the model on the order line; a customer's route is used by itself.

line.label: 3 · One order line
line.value: An exception, with a reason. Only the production manager makes it, until the basket cards are printed.

more.summary_one: More: the depth of {count} step (scan points, side by side, outside workshops, times, checkpoints, machine settings)
more.summary_other: More: the depth of {count} steps (scan points, side by side, outside workshops, times, checkpoints, machine settings)
more.stepsIntro: Revision {revision}: what each step needs on the floor.
more.minutesInBuilder: The steps, their order, their departments and their minutes change in the route builder ("Edit this route…").

problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not accepted: check the fields.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
problem.offline: The factory server is not answering: nothing was changed.
problem.unavailable: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.

save.line: Use this route for the order

builder.departmentsHint: Drag one into the route, or press +.
builder.noDepartments: No open department. Open one under Manage, or add one.
builder.routeHint: Drag a step to another place, or use the arrows. A department can be there twice.

keys.add: A department: drag it into the route, or press its +.
keys.move: A step: drag it, press its ↑ ↓, or Alt + ↑ / Alt + ↓ anywhere on its row.
keys.save: ⌘ Enter (Ctrl Enter) saves; Esc leaves without saving.

builder.dropEnd: Drop a department here: it goes to the end.
builder.empty: The route is empty. Drag a department here, or press its +.

error.NO_DEPARTMENT: Step {no} has no department: take it out.
error.MINUTES_BAD: Step {no}: the minutes are a number, like 12 or 12.5.
error.CUSTOMER_NEEDED: Choose the customer this route is for.
error.REASON_NEEDED: Say why this order is different.

note.NO_QUALITY: This route has no quality check. You can save it.
note.twice: {name} is there two times in a row. You can save it.

copy.label: Start from a copy, then change it
copy.find: Find a product to copy from
copy.failed: The routes to copy could not be read.

builder.name: The name of this route
builder.customersFailed: The customers could not be read: this route can be a model.
builder.reasonHint: The order's history keeps it (inside the factory only).
builder.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the customer sends the finished shells

template.label: Save it also as a ready-made route (every product can copy it)
template.done: “{name}” is a ready-made route now: every product can copy it.
template.takeOut: Take the ready-made route {name} out of the list (it is kept)
template.nameNeeded: Type a name for the ready-made route first.
template.nameTaken: A ready-made route with this name is there already. Type another name.
template.nameClosed: A closed ready-made route has this name. Open it again under “Closed routes”, or type another name.

refusal.NAME_TAKEN: This name is used by another department.
refusal.FLOOR_FIXED: This department has screens on the floor: its name stays and it cannot be closed.
refusal.FROZEN: The basket cards of this order are printed: the route of a line is fixed now.
refusal.PRINTED: The basket cards of this order are printed: the route of a line is fixed now.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: This revision is not a draft any more: its routes are frozen.
refusal.CLOSED: This department is closed: open it again before you change its name.
refusal.CODE_TAKEN: The operation code of this department is used by another operation of the library: give that one another code first.

manage.hint: Add a department, change its name, or close it. The departments on the floor keep their name and stay open. Press Manage again when you are done.
manage.closeHint: It leaves the list. The routes that use it keep it. Nothing is deleted.
manage.openHint: It comes back in the list.
manage.newLabel: The name of a new department
manage.nameFirst: Type the name of the new department first.

done.added: {name} is a new department: drag it into the route, or press its +.
done.renamed: The department is called {name} now: every route shows it.
done.closed: {name} is closed. It leaves the list; the routes that use it keep it.

line.info: Which departments each line goes through, and where that route comes from: the product, a model, the customer, the order structure, or only this order. Only people of the factory see it; the customer never sees a route.

answer.open: Sales picks the model of a line; the route comes with it. Another route is an exception of the production manager.
answer.frozen: Fixed at the print of the basket cards: the route of each line does not change here any more.
